form_success_message: Your alternate free-entry request was received. This is not confirmation of eligibility or an accepted entry. WeddingWin will validate the selected vendor draw, original submission time, submitted event revision, vendor offer version, rules version, named-vendor draw and marketing data-sharing acknowledgement, eligibility confirmations, and one-entry-per-eligible-couple limit.
operations_reconciliation: Form 354 inbox submission; an authenticated administrator must separately capture the submitted event revision and exact RFC 3339 vendor offer version, then match them with the immutable event key/revision, vendor user ID, rules version, original submission timestamp, and identified operator before an entry exists.

options.label: I confirm that I have reached the age of majority in my province or territory of residence.
I confirm that I live in the eligible region displayed for this vendor draw.
I confirm that I am not Wedding Win Inc., the named vendor, an employee of either, or a member of an excluded employee's immediate household under the Official Rules.

I reviewed and accept the WeddingWin Vendor Prize-Draw Official Rules version 2026-09-01-vendor-marketing and voluntarily request one entry for this eligible couple in the selected vendor draw. I understand that QR and alternate-method requests are combined and limited to one valid entry per eligible couple per vendor draw, regardless of method.

I understand the named vendor is the vendor-promotion sponsor, operator, and prize provider and is solely responsible for lawful promotion and prize terms, eligibility and winner-release decisions, the mathematical skill-testing question, prize restrictions, taxes, claims, disputes, delivery, and fulfilment. Wedding Win Inc. acts only as the technical platform and administrator for the named vendor's promotion; it is not the named vendor-promotion sponsor, operator, or prize provider and does not supply, guarantee, insure, or fulfil that vendor prize.

options.label: By entering, I agree that Wedding Win Inc. may share my name, email address, phone number (if provided), wedding date (if provided), and entry/consent evidence with the named vendor to administer this specific draw and for that vendor's own wedding-related offers and promotions. The vendor must identify itself and honour applicable unsubscribe or consent-withdrawal requests.
I understand Apple Inc. is not a sponsor, operator, prize provider, or administrator of this vendor draw and is not involved in entry, winner selection, verification, or prize fulfilment.
